# FieldMargin

`Flare.Components.FieldMargin`

Vertical (block) margin applied around a text field (FlareField / FlareTextField), mirroring the dense/normal spacing presets common in form layouts.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No outer margin (the default - spacing is left to the surrounding layout). |
| `Dense` | `1` | A small vertical margin above and below the field (compact forms). |
| `Normal` | `2` | A normal vertical margin above and below the field (comfortable forms). |

## Used by components

- `FlareField`
- `FlarePasswordField`
- `FlareTextField`
